description: Conduct a rapid literature review for recent advances (2023-2025) in Unsupervised Anomaly Detection for biomedical signals to identify gaps and suggest improvements for the discussion section.
Implement core anomaly detection logic for Biomedical Signal Processing, specifically focusing on Unsupervised Anomaly Detection using the specified baselines (Z-Score, LOF, Isolation Forest).
Implementacja głównego algorytmu oraz metody bazowej (baseline) w module core.py
Write comprehensive unit tests for the anomaly detection algorithms to ensure correctness and stability of the core module.
Ewaluacja empiryczna, wygenerowanie macierzy results.csv oraz wykresów w plot_results.py
Draft the methodology section (Rozdział 2) of the IEEE paper template, detailing the theoretical background and implementation of the selected baselines.
